UVCAndroid

Source: https://github.com/shiyinghan/UVCAndroid
Artifact: com.herohan:UVCAndroid:1.0.13
License: Apache License 2.0
License text: LICENSE.txt

OSS uses the public UVCAndroid CameraHelper / ICameraHelper API through
OssUvcVideoSource to detect UVC attach/open/permission/disconnect events and
route the camera preview to the RootEncoder SurfaceTexture. No UVCAndroid
source files are copied into this repository.
